24529.subject: English Language
24529.question_text:
From the words lettered A to E below each of the following sentences, choose the word that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word.
He eventually found the missing book.
24529.explanation:
"Eventually" means in the end, after a period of time or delay. It expresses the idea that something happened after other things or after some effort or time had passed.

A. soon – means in a short time from now, which implies quickly, not after a delay.

B. lately – means recently, not the same as eventually.

C. subsequently – means afterward, used in describing a sequence of events, but not necessarily after a long wait or effort.

D. frequently – means often, which is unrelated in meaning.

E. finally – means at last or after a long wait or delay, which is closest in meaning to "eventually."

From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the one that best completes each of the following sentences.
Hardly had he completed narrating the story......the poor woman collapsed.
24551.explanation:
This is a case of inversion used after negative adverbials such as hardly, scarcely or no sooner. The usual structure is:

  • Hardly/Scarcely... when

  • No sooner... than

So we say:

  • Hardly had he finished... when...

  • No sooner had he finished... than...
